method: same offline tools run on START_HEAD (before edits) and on the edited source tree; run-identity keys (label, backend path, runner file hash, module path) removed before comparing canonical JSON

ROUTE_PARITY.covers: B01–B04 historical accepted programs and 7 B02 fixtures: validator result, C1a ok/error_code/missing (count + hash)/legacy chan_doan codes and hash/weak/name map hash, route stage/error/executable/servable/failure_category/reason hash/details hash/weak/chan_doan_nghia_vu hash, scene3d hash, final_memory display and hash

RUNNER_PARITY.covers: R.main with scripted provider in ChanMangThat for C01/C02 × {accepted first, schema rejection then accepted, attempts exhausted} × {trace off, on}: exit code, envelope and scene3d hashes, answer readout, every request body hash (includes repair feedback), HTTP/retry/attempt counters, downstream failure class, common trace fields

SCENE_BASELINE.covers: frozen p1 and p6 programs through the product pipeline with replayed provider bytes: scene3d hash and topology

FINAL_MEMORY_FEEDBACK_BASELINE.covers: frozen p1/p6 final_memory hashes and values hash, derived C02 rejected program feedback bytes/hash and repair prompt size

trace_on_off_request_parity_on_coverage_: test_O (1 synthesis request, body hashes identical) and test_P (schema rejection then coverage rejection: 2 synthesis request bodies identical with trace off/on)
semantic_route_event_keys: unchanged for every outcome except a C1a rejection, which adds coverage_diagnostic
envelope_change: none — envelopes are built from envelope/reason/error_code/stage_reached, not from the new field

CACHE_VERSION.reason: no served envelope, prompt, schema, grammar card or capability changed; cache identity lock verifies
